about: Pass 5 (2026-10-08): search for independent results for 79 maker-only models. Outcome: no new rows. data/ not edited. Search tooling was limited to web search, arXiv API (abstract-level) and HF API; no full-text paper search was available, so coverage below rank ~10 is shallow.

gaps.why: Only Mistral's arXiv:2603.25551 reports it. Papers citing it (Voxtral ASR/ALM papers, TontaubeV1 2609.08703, Fish S2 report) do not run Voxtral TTS; TontaubeV1 compares Fish S2 Pro, ElevenLabs, Gradium, Cartesia only and has the default arXiv licence.

Only Fish Audio's own blog/model card numbers. Independent arXiv papers found (Beyond Prompt Adherence 2608.00545, CC BY) audit Fish-Speech-S2, CosyVoice3 and VoxCPM2, not S1. TTS-Arena-V2 and Arabic arena already used or unlicensed.
